senses.sense_definition: Relating to or characteristic of the political ideology of populism.

examples.text: The party adopted a <w>populist</w> platform to appeal to the working class.

target_lang_translations.zh: 该党采取了<w>民粹主义的</w>纲领以争取工人阶级。

examples.text: Many voters were drawn to his <w>populist</w> rhetoric during the election campaign.

target_lang_translations.zh: 在竞选期间，许多选民被他的<w>民粹主义</w>言论所吸引。

target_lang_definitions.zh: 与民粹主义政治意识形态相关的或具有其特征的。

zh.target_lang_sense_clarification: 形容词，指代民粹主义政治倾向。

senses.sense_definition: Designed or proposed primarily to gain public approval rather than for practical effectiveness.

examples.text: The government introduced a <w>populist</w> tax cut that economists warned would increase inflation.

target_lang_translations.zh: 政府推出了一项<w>迎合民意的</w>减税政策，经济学家警告称这会加剧通货膨胀。

examples.text: Critics dismissed the new policy as a purely <w>populist</w> measure intended to boost poll numbers.

target_lang_translations.zh: 批评人士认为这项新政策纯粹是旨在提高民调支持率的<w>迎合民意</w>之举。

target_lang_definitions.zh: 主要为了博取公众好感而非出于实际效果而设计或提出的。

zh.target_lang_sense_clarification: 形容词，指为了讨好大众而采取的手段。

senses.sense_definition: Relating to the interests or opinions of ordinary people.

examples.text: The candidate focused on a <w>populist</w> agenda that prioritized the needs of the common citizen.

target_lang_translations.zh: 该候选人专注于将普通公民需求置于首位的<w>平民主义</w>议程。

examples.text: She argued that the <w>populist</w> approach was the only way to restore faith in democratic institutions.

target_lang_translations.zh: 她认为，这种<w>平民主义的</w>方法是恢复对民主制度信心的唯一途径。

target_lang_definitions.zh: 与普通民众的利益或观点相关的。

zh.target_lang_sense_clarification: 形容词，强调关注普通人的立场。

senses.sense_definition: A person who supports a political movement that claims to represent the interests of ordinary people against an elite.

examples.text: The <w>populist</w> promised to challenge the established political order.

target_lang_translations.zh: 这位<w>民粹主义者</w>承诺要挑战既定的政治秩序。

examples.text: As a dedicated <w>populist</w>, he frequently criticized the influence of wealthy corporations on government.

target_lang_translations.zh: 作为一名坚定的<w>民粹主义者</w>，他经常批评大企业对政府的影响。

target_lang_definitions.zh: 支持声称代表普通民众利益对抗精英阶层的政治运动的人。

zh.target_lang_sense_clarification: 名词，指代持有民粹主义立场的人。

senses.sense_definition: A politician who promotes policies solely to gain popularity.

examples.text: The opposition leader was labeled a <w>populist</w> who ignored long-term economic consequences.

target_lang_translations.zh: 反对党领袖被贴上了忽视长期经济后果的<w>投机政客</w>标签。

examples.text: He is a classic <w>populist</w> who tells the crowd exactly what they want to hear.

target_lang_translations.zh: 他是一个典型的<w>投机政客</w>，只会对民众说他们想听的话。

target_lang_definitions.zh: 为了获得人气而专门推行某种政策的政客。

zh.target_lang_sense_clarification: 名词，贬义，指为了选票而迎合大众的政客。

senses.sense_definition: A person who advocates for democratic principles.

examples.text: The historical figure was remembered as a <w>populist</w> who fought for universal voting rights.

target_lang_translations.zh: 这位历史人物被铭记为一位为普选权而奋斗的<w>平民主义者</w>。

examples.text: She considered herself a <w>populist</w> committed to the expansion of civil liberties.

target_lang_translations.zh: 她认为自己是一位致力于扩大公民自由的<w>平民主义者</w>。

zh.target_lang_sense_clarification: 名词，指代主张平民权利的人。
